nativeFrameTokenCoverage.scope: Union of temporally disambiguated exact token spans in all final recorded native question frames, including cancelled/superseded/unfinished jobs. Case and punctuation are ignored. Coverage establishes retained text somewhere in the recording, not per-utterance delivery, current selected context, semantic preservation or correct visible answers.

instrumentationChange.scope: The additional observer began during playback and read previously retained events. Its CPU/memory and CDP polling are extra instrumentation; native process-tree and main recorder measurements exclude this separate observer. Timing drift across its start is not an isolated model or app effect.

drift.scope: Descriptive temporal halves using native job speech-end times calibrated to the physical playback midpoint. Jobs may combine source utterances; missing/cancelled jobs stay in each denominator. Complete-job statistics are explicitly conditional. Source repeats and partial cycles give dependent and unequal workload samples. The event observer started during playback; its additional load prevents an isolated causal drift claim. Startup/warm-up memory growth is not a leak proof. Working-set sums may double count shared pages; GPU and sibling process allocations are excluded. No predeclared significant-degradation threshold or population certification is inferred.

intervals.visibleText: If it accelerates, the distance depends on the acceleration. Assuming constant acceleration a, an initial speed of 20 meters per second, and the same 30 seconds, displacement is 20 × 30 + ½ × a × 30² = 600 + 450a meters, with a in meters per second squared. This also equals distance traveled if the vehicle never reverses direction; without an acceleration value or profile, there’s no unique numerical answer.
